source.title: Impeachment Trial of Vice President Sara Duterte

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The Sergeant at Arms is directed to make a proclamation.

turns.speaker: Alfredo Sotto Corpuz
turns.text: All persons are commanded to keep silent under pain of penalty while the impeachment court is in session for the trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte is hereby called to order. We shall be led in prayer by Senator Judge Juan Miguel Zubiri.

turns.speaker: Sen. Juan Miguel “Migz” F. Zubiri
turns.text: In the name of the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit. Amen. Dear Lord, we come to you today with prayers for your grace and mercy for our country and our people. As we carry on with our pursuit of truth and justice, may you remind us always of the wisdom of the book of Ecclesiastes 3.1-8. There is a time for everything and a season for every activity under the heavens, a time to be born and a time to die. A time to plant and a time to harvest. A time to kill and a time to heal. A time to tear down and a time to build. A time to weep and a time to laugh. A time to scatter stones and a time to gather them. A time to embrace and a time to refrain from embracing. A time to search and a time to give up. A time to keep and a time to throw away. A time to tear and a time to mend. A time to be silent and a time to speak. A time to love and a time to hate. A time for war and a time for peace. Lord, let everyone in this room be your instruments in ushering in a time of peace, togetherness, and healing for our beloved nation. Amen.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The Clerk of Court will now call the roll.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Roll call of members. Senator-Judge Aquino. Senator-Judge Cayetano, Alan. Senator-Judge Cayetano, Pia. Senator-Judge Dela Rosa. Senator-Judge Villar Camille, Senator-Judge Villar Mark, Senator-Judge Zubiri, The Presiding Officer Senator-Judge Escudero, The Senate President Senator-Judge Gatchalian.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: With 14 Senator-Judges present, the Chair declares the presence of a quorum. In accordance with the Rules of Procedure on Impeachment Trials, the Chair now recognizes the duly elected Presiding Officer to preside over the proceedings of the Impeachment Court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Senate President. If there are no objections, we shall dispense with the reading of the journal, journal number 37, for October 12 and October 13 of the Senate, sitting as an impeachment court, and shall consider the same as approved.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The Clerk of Court will please call the case before the impeachment court.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Case number 004-2026, in the matter of impeachment trial, Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Before asking for the appearances of the parties, the Presiding Officer would like to make some remarks. In order to update the senator judges, the parties, and the public with respect to what happened in the course of the recess.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The chair deems it necessary to place on record certain developments that have transpired since the adjournment of the proceedings on October 13, 2026. In particular, the chair would like to take this opportunity to appraise the parties of the pleadings and submissions received as well as the corresponding orders issued during the recess. This is intended to place relevant documents on the record. and provide proper context for the continuation of today's proceedings. First, reconsideration of the ruling on the application of Rule 18. Following the decision of the prosecution to withdraw Articles 1, 2, and 4 of the Articles of Impeachment, the Chair stated that the subjudicial principle under Rule 18 of the Rules of Procedure on Impeachment Trials shall no longer apply to the withdrawn articles. After Council for Respondent through Attorney Sison registered its objection to the abandonment of Rule 18, Senator Judge Pangilinan, Move for reconsideration or appeal of the chair's ruling and the body. Authorize the presiding officer to rule on the reconsideration or appeal during the recess. In view of the respondents, November 4, 2026 manifestation, on her non-waiver of Rule 18. The court acting on the appeal of Senator Judge Pangilinan issued an order dated November 5, 2026, resolving the subjudice principle under Rule 18 of the Rules of Procedure on Impeachment Trials shall continue to apply with equal force to all articles of impeachment, whether withdrawn or pending adjudication. And reiterating the August 26, 2026 ruling of the court enjoining all covered persons to refrain from issuing public statements or commentaries in violation of section of rule 18 rather. Second, order the prosecution's formal offer of evidence. In compliance with the court's directive, the prosecution filed its formal offer of evidence on October 20, 2026 and the respondent filed their comment on October 30, 2026. The court resolved the formal offer in its November 5, 2026 order, copies of which were furnished to the panel of prosecutors and counsel for respondent, as well as the senator judges. Accordingly, the prosecution is deemed to have rested its evidence-in-chief on Article 2.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Next, respondent's manifestation regarding its witnesses. The court has also received the respondents' manifestations dated November 4 and 5, 2026. The November 4 manifestation lists 24 witnesses for the November 9 to 13, 2026 hearings and requests subpoenas for them. The November 5 manifestation withdraws Dean Ralph A. Sarmiento as a witness and requests the recall of the subpoena issued for him. On Dean Sarmiento, the November 5 manifestation is noted. The court clarifies that no subpoena has yet been issued to Dean Sarmiento and thus no withdrawal is necessary. On other witnesses, the respondent by counsel filed a manifestation on November 6, 2026 stating that one of its witnesses, Attorney Suzette Balucanagpunay, who was subpoenaed to appear as its first witness, will undergo MRI examination on November 9 and will thus not be able to appear as scheduled. The respondent does request that her presentation be reset to November 10 and to proceed with the succeeding witnesses. The prosecution filed a comment on respondent's manifestation with request for subpoena dosis tecum on November 6, 2026. The court is in receipt. of the Council for Respondents' Latest Manifestation dated November 7, 2026, listing the intended names of witnesses to be presented from November 9 to 13 and the respective purposes for their testimonies. Accordingly, the court, number 1, grants the respondent's request in her manifestation dated November 6 on witness Suzette Punay that she may appear on November 10. Number 2, notes the November 6 comment of the prosecution and the manifestation. 3. Notes the respondents of the November 7, 2026 Manifestation reiterating her request through counsel for the issuance of subpoenas at the Certificandum Induces Tecum to witnesses Attorney Anel S. Antero, Mr. Chadrin Parian, and Bimar M. Barceliano who are scheduled for presentation on November 9-13 for purposes stated in the Manifestation. Subpoenas will accordingly be issued by the Court today. Finally, On the reclassification of access to exhibits, the presiding officer on November 6, 2026 issued an order governing the classification of exhibits attached to the prosecution's formal offer of evidence and corollary manner and extent of access to it. A copy of the order was furnished to the parties and the senator judges accordingly.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Good morning, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: You, Jaime Adalin, do swear that the evidence you shall give in the case now pending between the Philippines and Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte shall be the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth. So help you God.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Atty. Adalin, pakisagot po sa mikropono para marinig po at malagay sa record.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Naunawa niyo po ang inyong pinanumpaan?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Jimmy po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Jimmy?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes, your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Engineer Jimmy.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: May I proceed, Your Honor?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed, Counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. The testimony of Engineer Jaime G. Adalin is offered to prove that he is the City Assessor of Davao City, his duties and responsibilities, and that he has personal knowledge on tax declarations concerning the real property covered by TCT No.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: 2024-010,146-2024-010775 to prove that the real property covered by the said transfer certificate of title is disclosed by the vice president in her statement of assets, liabilities, and net worth to prove that the prosecution's accusation that the respondent did not disclose. Said transfer certificate of title and the real property in her statement of assets, liabilities, and net worth is malicious and completely false. To identify and authenticate tax declarations and other related documents concerning the transfer certificate of title number 146-12024010775 and to prove other relevant matters.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Atty. Tolosa?

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Just to abbreviate the proceedings, with respect to the offer number one, we're willing to stipulate regarding the position of this witness and that he has personal knowledge regarding the issuance of the tax declaration covered by the TCT mentioned during the offer. With respect to offer number two, that the testimony of this witness would supposedly establish that that TCT was disclosed in the SALN of the Vice President. We object to that for being improper and misleading. There's no way that this witness could prove that that property indicated in the SALN is the same property covered by the subject TCT. The only thing that this witness could testify on is that Possibly, these two properties are in the same barangay. But that will not in any way prove that they are talking about the same property considering the glaring discrepancies between the two, specifically with respect to the acquisition value.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: declared into those two documents. And for the reason number three, we also vehemently oppose that, especially their characterization that our position that that property covered by the TCT was not disclosed in the SALN was maliciously and completely false. We take the strongest exceptions to these accusations, Your Honor. It cannot be said that it's completely false because again, just a mere Facial examination of those two documents would show that there are obvious discrepancies between the two.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Can I reply, Your Honor?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: No need, counsel. Duly noted, subject to cross, you may proceed with your direct examination, Attorney Lindon.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Good morning, Engineer Jaime Adalin.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Good morning, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Please state your name for the record, sir.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Good morning, Your Honors. I am Jaime Gallinero Adalin. resident of Cabantian, Davao City.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: How long have you been a resident of Cabantian, sir? Am I correct, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: How long have you been a resident of Cabantian, Davao City, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: More or less, nasa 10 years na ako sa Cabantian, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: What is your profession, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: I am a civil engineer by profession and at the same time a real estate appraiser.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: How long have you been the civil engineer?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: I passed the board exam sometime in 1984, so more or less 23 years, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: How about how long have you been a real estate appraiser?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: I passed the licensure examination sometime in 2015, so that would be 9 years.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: What is your present occupation, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Currently, I am the city assessor of Davao, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: How long have you been the City Assessor of Davao City?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: More or less nasa nine years, although in Cotabato City, galing ako doon in the City Assessor's Office also.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: What are your duties and responsibilities as the City Assessor of Davao City, Sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Among others, number one is to ensure that all those governing real property shall be properly executed. to establish a systematic real property assessment including a systematic identification and accounting system and also to issue certification as to the records of assessment and other relevant information.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Sir, I just ask you to speak more clearly and louder at the microphone.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Okay, yes sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Thank you sir. Just a follow-up question, sir, regarding your duties and responsibilities. Does it require you to be familiar with the different barangays in Davao City?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: What records are maintained in the City Assessor's Office of Davao City, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Number one, as required by the manual issued by the Department of Finance, of course, the tax declaration, tax month, and other Tax mapping control role, quarterly report on real property assessment, notice of assessment, and all others, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Are there any other documents, sir? Or is that all you can remember, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: That includes assessment role and property record form or the ownership record form.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Sir, you mentioned tax maps, correct, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: What are tax maps, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Tax maps are one of the most important tools in real property assessment. The tax map establishes a permanent link between real property on the ground and the records of the city assessor's office.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: How are tax maps created, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: The tax maps are being created to start with the gathering of data that includes approved survey including also cadastral survey and that will form part of the base map and after such it will be segregated and magkakaroon ng mga section maps, index maps, barangay maps.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Sino po yung gumagawa ng mga tax map na ito sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: In our office, we have a tax mapping operation division that will take charge of the preparation of the maps including gathering of data and information.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Pag nagawa na po itong tax map, sino po yung nag-a-approve kung alam niyo po?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Ang approval po, just to abide with the guidelines prescribed by the BLGF, ang city assessor po ang nag-a-approve. It is prepared by the tax mapper and verified by the division head of the tax mapping operation division.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Thank you, sir. What is the purpose of a tax map, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: The purpose of tax map is to properly identify the properties on the ground and to discover properties that may have been covered by assessment. And as I was saying a while ago, it will establish a link. Between the real properties on the ground and the records, without the tax map, it would be hard for us to determine ano ba yung mga properties na wala pang assessment.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Sir, I would just ask you to clarify, what is this link? Why is it important to establish such link?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Pardon, sir?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Why is it important to establish this link you mentioned?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Again, kapag hindi po kasi natin na-establish sa MAPA yung mga real properties na yan, napakahirap po siyang magawa ng assessment for taxation purposes. At yan din po ang MAPA na ginagamit ng Treasurer's Office for the Collection of Real Property Tax.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Thank you, Sir. Sir, how do you ensure the accuracy of tax maps?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: To ensure accuracy, recently, may ginagamit na po tayong tool or yung QGIS map wherein maps are being plotted based on technical description. Nung una, manual po yan siya na parang video drawing lang based on the approved survey but in most cases, other LGUs, other assessors are now Going into QGIS mapping. Ginagawa na po namin yan sa Davao City.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Sorry sir, can you repeat? What is QDS mapping?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: QGIS mapping, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Ano pong ibig sabihin nun, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: It is somewhat a system that you will encode the technical description as described in the title. Then the technical description, the system will plot the exact geographical presentation. or drone to a scale.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Okay. So, just to clarify, sir, is it this system which helps in generating the tax maps?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: You're correct, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: You also mentioned, sir, that the City Assessor's Office of Davao City also maintains tax declarations, sir. You remember that, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: You're correct, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: What are tax declarations, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Tax declaration is issued by the assessor informing the owner of the property, describing also the description kung ano yung property na yan. Also included there are the market value and the assessed value. Again, as a basis for the city treasurer to compute for the basic and SEF tax.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Sir, anong tax po ba ang may kinalaman sa tax declaration?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Basically, yung pong real property tax and SEF or special education fund.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Ito po bang nabanggit yung real property tax? Pareho lang to sa tinatawag nilang amilyar? O may pagkakaiba po ba?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Tingin ko pare lang po. Parang old term po yung amilyar na yan.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Sir, paano po binabayaran yung real property taxes?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Normally, yung aming tax declaration na in-issue, yun po ang dinadala ng taxpayer sa City Treasurer's Office and then naka-automate na po yan. Pag-present po ng tax declaration, i-compute po yung statement of account ng City Treasurer's Office.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Sino po ba yung mga kailangan magbayad ng real property tax?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Normally, ang magbabayad talaga yung property owner.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Property owner. May alam pa po ba kayong instances na hindi property owner ang nagbabayad?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: I'm not quite aware, no? Kasi ang collection is na sa city treasurer. I'm also not aware if the treasurer would require authorization. But as far as tax declaration, na doon lang po kami.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Thank you, sir. Sir, in relation to this case, Do you confirm having received a subpina, ducis tecum, and subpina ad testificandum, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes, I am aware to receive sometime last week.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: What documents did you bring in compliance with the subpina you received, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: I submitted three sets.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Sir, sorry. Can you kindly enumerate each document you received, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Okay. I submitted in three sets the tax declaration covering title number 146-2024-01-10-775 in three sets including the tax map. We have the administrative district map, the barangay map, and the property identification map. including certifications, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Your Honor, at this point, may we just ask Your Honor for, from the witness, copies of the documents he produced in court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, please.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: And with due respect, Your Honor, if we can also be given a few minutes to examine and peruse.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: We have copies of the tax declaration, but to ensure that all the other, to examine the other documents which was brought by the witness and which we may have not any copy, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Engineer Jimmy, ilan pong dokumento ang dala ninyo?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Meron po akong dalang tatlong dokumento, sets of documents. Kinuha na po ng isa.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Senate. Mayroon pa akong dalawa dito.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: May copy na tayo, Atty. Ray.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly reproduce it and furnish the counsel for the panel of prosecutors with a copy.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Your correct honor. Vice versa po siya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Vice versa rin siya. Pero nakita naman natin kanina, eh kainan ho yan. So dapat i-classify ho yan as komersyal. So, kukorek ko lang kayo doon. So, pupunta na po ako sa aking katanungan. Yung property na ipinakita ko kanina, yan po ba ay pagmamayari po ni Atty. Manases at Vice President Sara?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: That is correct, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: At yan po ay napuntahan niyo personally?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Pinainspeko po doon sa aming technical staff just to confirm. kung talagang yan yung subject property. And they confirmed it, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Hindi ito, hindi ito, hindi itong, hindi itong... Showing what's appearing in the screen.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I don't believe that's the basis of the Senate President's questions. Kindly turn the screen off. Tech.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: In building, in building po yung pinapointa ko. So pinapuntahan niyo po sa inspector at yun po yung... Yung po yung building at property na pinag-uusapan ngayon.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Hindi ko po napansin yung pangalan na ano yan? Dabaw...

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Ano po yan? Dabaw

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Prime.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Ang nakita ko po doon sa picture is yung building lang itself.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Ito?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yan, yan po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Ito ho, itong building na ito, pagmamayari po ni Atty. Manases. At

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: ito rin po yung title ending 0775.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Diyan po naka-construct.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Dito po naka-construct. At ito po yung naka-connect sa inyong tax declaration na pinakita kanina ng defense.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: You're correct, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Ngayon, tinitignan ko ho yung SALN. Gusto ko rin ho malaman kung paano ho, kasi kanina nung nasabi nyo, Itong property na ito at yung sa SALN, yung Barangay 74A is one and the same. Pero tinitignan ko dito sa SALN, wala naman pong nakasulat na title number. Wala rin pong nakasulat na tax declaration number. So paano nyo nasabi na yan na yan ang property na nakadeclare dito?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Nag-base pa ako doon sa access value na nakalagay na...

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: 82,046, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Yung assessed value ang ginamitan niyong basehan. Tapos ginamitan niyo rin basehan, I guess, yung market value.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes. At saka po yung pinakitang e-card kanina that nakareflect po yung previous tax declaration na nakalagay din po dito sa baba.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Pero iba po pagdating naman po doon sa purchase value.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes, probably. Kasi purchase, it's again, it's beyond our jurisdiction to determine the purchase price.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Tinitignan ko ho rin kanina, ipakibalik ho yung kaninang thin lash, yung site, yung vicinity map, or yung yan, ipakizoom out. Kasi pag titignan niyo ho yung lupa nito, halos magkakaparehas po yung cut.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Halos magkakapareha swing cut. So, ibig sabihin na ho, yung kanilang assessed value at yung kanilang fair market value, current market value, pwede ho pare-pareho, di ba ho? Kasi tingnan niyo ho, subdivision ho sila eh.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: In that case, Your Honor, yan pong subject property was subdivided. I just can't recall kung kailan. Na-subdivide po yan, kaya pansin niyo po ninyo, yung pula, merong maliit na katabi. Dahil hinati po siya, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Ayan po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Yan bang pula? Yan ba ho yung property na tinutukoy?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes. Yan pong maliit is another property na sinubdivide po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Okay. Yung mga ibang property, nakita ko, pare-pareho yung hugis eh. So, ibig sabihin, pwede ho magkaroon ng tax declaration. Na halos pare-parehas ang assessed value at market value dahil pag makikita ho na, tinitignan ko lang ho sa picture ha, wala akong sukat ha. At

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: pag titignan ho natin yan by visual observation, pwede ho magkaroon ng maraming pare-parehong hugis ng lupa. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes, most probably, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Thank you. Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you. Senator Judge Villanueva is recognized. You may proceed, sir. You have two minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. President.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Sir Witness, magandang hapon po.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Magandang hapon po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Unang tanong ko, may masama ko ba pag kayo'y nagpunta ng China o wala naman?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Wala naman po siguro, wala na na kung personal na ang travel.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Naniniwala din po ako doon, kaya maganda na malinaw po na wala namang masama kung pumunta ko kay China.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Gusto kong pag-usapan itong... Property na pinag-uusapan kanina pa. If we can flash in the screen yung sale ng 2024. Engineer, ano po yung pinagkaiba ba as an assessor, city assessor, ng assessed value, fair market value sa tax declaration at actual acquisition cost or consideration paid for a property?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Ang assessed value po ay

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Doon po yan binabase sa tax declaration na naming na issue. Yung acquisition cost, in my understanding, is kung magkano po yung sabihin natin na actual na bintahan or nakalagay sa deduct sale. Kami po is doon lang po sa assessed value.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: So ang city assessor po ba, kagaya po ninyo, independently verify what the buyer? Actually paid or rely on or you just rely on documents and assessment schedules?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Independent po yung appraisal na ginagawa ng assessor. It is always based on the approved schedule of market values with the appropriate ordinance.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: And you verify what the buyer actually paid?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Hindi na po. Ang pagkaalam ko po yan sa BAR.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Sige po, hindi ko na babanggitin itong maraming batas tungkol po dyan. 6713, Section 199 ng Local Government Code. At dito po kasi sa Impeachment Court ay nareceive namin yung LRA deed entitled as recorded property conveyance evidence but Reserved po whether any material SALN omission was actually proved. What can be proved? Ang gusto ko lang ipunto ay magkakahiwalay po yung tatlong halaga na hinihingi sa SALN. Linawin po natin kung aling halaga talaga ang galing po sa CT assessment at kung alin ang makikita sa deed o sa ibang transaction record.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: You're correctly honored.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Last question. Before the July 2024 sale, magkano po yung assessed value ng lot under the seller's tax declaration?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Before the July

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: 2024 sale.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: In the name of the previous owner, your honor. As indicated in our tax declaration, the market value is 2 million. 51,150 pesos.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Assessed value po yun.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Assessed value is 82,046.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Now, when your office transferred the declaration to Atty. Carpio, did you carry over the 82,046 or compute a new value?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: It is carry over.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Carry over po. Maaari po ba na ipakita yung previous and replacement declarations? And identify which one was on file as of 31st of December 2024.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Pwede po ba yun? Mapapakita po natin yun.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Sa pangalan po ng previous owner?

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Opo, tsaka yung previous and replacement declarations.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes, actually nasubmit po namin yan.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: At tingin ko na-present kanina yung tax declaration sa previous owner.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Efectiva 2019.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Kasi ho, Mr. Witness, yung Korte can check, hindi ho ba, when the figure first appeared and which declaration contained it at the year end. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: You're correct.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Ano ho ba yung nakalagay doon? Yung huling tanong ko. Nagtutugma po ba?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes, nagtutugma po. Yung previous na... Assess value is 82,046 pesos. At yung na-transfer na po kay Atty. Manases Carpio, ganun din po, 82,046.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Yun po yung assess, no? Pero yung market value, ang laki.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Which is about 10 million. Ang laki ho nung difference. Ganun po talaga, no?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Ganun po talaga.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Para po kukunti na lang yung buwis na bayaran. Lahat

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: naman po, ganun. Would you agree?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Ang base yan po kasi ng assessed value is yung certain percentage applied doon sa aming market value computed based on the schedule of market values approved.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Which is again, huge difference. Thank you,

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Mr. Wittes. Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator Judge Villanueva. To avail of the second round, Senator Judge Hontiveros.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Salamat po, Mr. Presiding Officer. Magandang hapon po muli, Engineer.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Good afternoon, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Naalala niyo na po ba kung saan kayo sa China pumunta nung January 2026?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Pwede ko kaya kayo, parang gusto ko sanang i-inquire doon sa aming admin ba?

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Pwede rin naman po, pero to confirm na lang kasi dahil hindi niyo sinasagot kanina, nag-humingi po ako ng yung mga datos na yun. And so may information po ako na January 25 sa flight BR358, lumipad kayo mula Manila hanggang Beijing.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: You're correct.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: I'm correct pala po eh. Sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Na-verify na po kasi ninyo siguro.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Ano sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Na-verify na po ba?

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Hindi pa nga verified. Wala kayong sinabi sa akin eh na pwede kong i-verify. Ito po ay impormasyon na niresearch na lang po namin. January 30 naman po. Lumipad kayo PR339 mula Shanghai, pabalik dito sa Manila. So, naalala nyo na po ba na pumunta kayong Beijing at Shanghai noong January ngayong taon?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Most probably, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Sir, kanina, I mean, pumansin din na lagi yung ginagamit yung salitang most probably. Unbelievable na makarating sa isang great capital tulad ng Beijing at isang magandang sudad tulad ng Shanghai at di nyo maalala. Just for the record. So, sino po ang nagdala sa inyo sa Beijing at sino po ang naghatid sa inyo pa uwi galing Shanghai?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Honestly,

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: I'm very sure, Your Honor, na pumunta kami. But on sino po ang nag-facilitate, sino ang nag-guide, hindi ko na po ma-recall. But what I am sure is that is a personal travel, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Sir, kung alam ng travel authorities natin na tumating kayong Beijing and then mula Shanghai bumalik kayong Manila, you must have. Unless may doppelganger po kayo dito sa Pilipinas hanggang sa China. Si Mayor Baste, Tuterte ba ang nagsama sa inyo sa engineering head nyo, sa treasury head nyo dito sa Beijing at saka Shanghai noong January?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Hindi po kasama ang aming mayor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Sino yung highest ranking na official na kasama nyo sa trip na iyon?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Ang marikol ko po ang aming city administrator.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: City administrator ang highest ranking and then the rest ay kayo pong mga department heads. Kasama na po kayo. Sige po, ilang huling mga tanong lamang.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Tungkos sa i-request ko pong dokumentong ma-isumite nyo sa Korte sa pamamagitan ng presiding officer. Kanina po sinabi nyo naman na computerized na po ang sistema sa Davao City, tama po?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Alright. Kung ganun, since computerized naman din po, siguro naman madaling i-check kung may iba pang mga properties si Atty. Man Scarpio sa Davao City. Kaya nyo pong i-check within today or even within the hour, tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Pwede naman po siguro, i-request namin yung aming records officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Yes. Pakirequest at engineer ang inyong records office or records officer, i-furnish ang impeachment court nitong mga impormasyon kung ano po lahat ang mga properties ni Atty. Carpio sa Davao City. Maari po ba, engineer?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes, I will request.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Yes, and please ask them to submit to the court within this hour at the latest within the day. Laging salamat, Engineer.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Laging salamat po, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator Judge Riza. What is the pleasure of Senator Judge Kiko?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Thank you. Magandang hapon, Engineer.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Magandang hapon po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Kanina, nung ikaw ay nag-testify, tinanong sa'yo tungkol dito sa titulo o yung property na nasa SALN at yung property description na nasa deed of sale. At sinabi mo, one and the same. Tama?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Sabi mo, one and the same. Sinabi mo, nakakatiyak ka na yung lupa na nakalagay doon sa SALN, yun din yung lupa na nakalagay doon sa deed of sale, tama?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor, based on the eCAR.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Yes. Ngayon, nung ipinakita sa iyo yung picture ng prime dining, sabi mo hindi mo alam kung yun ba, tama?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So paano mo masasabing tiyaka na yun yung property nung ipinakita sa iyo ay hindi mo alam?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yun po kasing picture, parang may pangalan. Kasi yung signage or yung business name, hindi po ako pamilyar doon. So

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: in other words...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Yung sinabi mong tiyak ka na yung nasa SALN at yung nasa DDoS sale ay iisa, hindi mo pala alam. Kasi nung pinakita sa'yo, hindi mo alam eh. Pero nung pagkatapos ng lunch, tinanong sa'yo, sabi mo, kinausap mo yung tao mo, yun pala. So bakit pabago-bago? Tiyak ka, hindi ka tiyak. Tapos ngayon tiyak ka na naman dahil nagtanong ka dun sa mga tao mo. So ano yung totoo? Ano yung hindi totoo? Ano yung tiyak? Ano yung hindi tiyak?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yan po kasi yung picture kanina na pinakita na merong name ng business.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Doon pa ako hindi sure.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Kasi normally...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Kasi kung tiyak ka, di dapat nung nakita mo, alam mo. Sabi mo yun yung iisan... Iisa yun eh, di ba? Iisa yung nasa SALN na description, iisa rin yung nandun sa deed of sale. So sabi mo, tiyak. Pero nung nakita yung property, sabi mo, hindi mo alam. Tapos nung nagtanong ka, yun pala. Alam mo pala. Alam mo na.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Kasi po, yung picture na pinakita lately na walang nakalagay na business name, Ayun din po nakita ko doon sa picture na sinambit sa amin ng aming mga appraiser. Usually take pictures eh. Pero kung nakalagay yung signage na yun ang business niya, doon ako hindi sure. Kasi ang picture po namin, wala namang ganun nakalagay na bistro. Ano ba yun nakalagay doon?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So ano yung totoo? Sure, hindi sure?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Pardon? Pardon sir?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So what is, ano talaga ang totoo? Sure ka dahil sinabi mong tiya ka tapos hindi ka sure? Tapos ngayon, sure ka na ulit. Ano ba?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yung picture po na pinakita na walang name ng business, doon ako sure na talagang yun siya.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Magkaiba kasi sila eh.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Pero ngayon, magtanong ka, di mo alam, ngayon alam

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: mo na. Anyway, I have no further questions. Just a observation that clearly, there are inconsistencies in your testimony. Forgive me, Engineer, but you say one thing and then you say another thing. So we are wondering, ano ba talaga ang totoo sa sinasabi mo? Just for the record, Mr. President.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you. Finally, Senator Judge Erwin Tulfo for his... Raffy?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Senator Raffy Tulfo, rather, for his second round. Apologies, Senator Judge Raffy. You may proceed, sir. You have two minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Just like what Senator...

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: There's nothing wrong for anybody to go to China. Pero kung nang-sponsor is Chinese government, then may problema. Kaya yun ang tinatanong ko ngayon.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Sino po ang nag-sponsor ng trip niya sa China? Would you know?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Personal travel po namin yan, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Personal travel. Ilan kayo?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Para mga 6 ato o 7?

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: 6-7. So pinag-usapan nyo 7 kayo na mag-travel sa channel. On a personal matter, is that what it is?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes, correct, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: And then, same thing noong November 2018? Kasi noong November 2018, two days lang. And then noong January 25, 26, five days lang. So all of these are personal money ninyo?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Sino-sino po ulit ang mga kasama nyo?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: If I can recall, yung January, nakasama po namin yung aming administrator and city engineer and city treasurer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: So naka-declare to sa inyong travel authority?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Na you are using personal funds?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Sa plane ticket and all? At kayo po mismo ang bumili ng plane ticket?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: At which travel agency ito?

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Yes. Kasi kayo mismo pumunta sa travel agency? para bumili ng ticket. Or somebody bought your tickets through the travel agency or the travel agency bought the tickets for you guys?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: What I can recall is...

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Anong pangalan ng travel agency at the same time follow-up ko?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Pardon sir?

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Kasi ikaw ba mismo pumunta sa PAL para bumili ng ticket o gumamit ka ng travel agency?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: If I can recall, nag-assign kami ng isang tao to facilitate the procurement of the ticket, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: So meron kayong tao ang kinausap para mag-facilitate ng tickets ninyo?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: As a group, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: So group to rito?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: So ibig sabihin dumaan kayo sa travel agency? Kasi kung group to, travel agency yan eh. Most probably yun.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Anong pangalan po ng travel agency?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Hindi ko talaga ma-memorize.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Diyan ka na naman. Nagkakaroon ka ng amnesia. Of

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: course, you should know that. Kasi sabi mo, group kayo. Siyempre, kung pera ninyo yan, alamin nyo kung anong pangalan ng travel agency para makatipid kayo. Mahal ba yan? O kilala ba yung travel agency na yan? O dati pa, palpak na yan. Marami na ginagawa ang kalukuan. E maghanap tayo ng magandang travel agency. Ganon dapat. Engineer ka pa man din. Kung baga, kung ano nang sabihin ng mga kasama mo, bahala na.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Am I allowed to... Kung baga to furnish officially kung after checking, pwede po ba yan?

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Yes, pwede po yan. Siguro. Mr. Presiding Officer, pwede ba mag-furnish na siya after checking yung pangalan travel agency?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Para sigurado lang po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: When, Engineer Jimmy?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Upon going back to the office, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: With the permission of Senator Judge Raffy, he can just simply inform the Clerk of Court if that is okay with him.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: That's okay with me. Okay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly, the clerk is directed to kindly coordinate with Engineer Jimmy for the travel agency, name of the travel agency concerned.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes, Yon.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Noong 2018, personal expenses, personal money din ang ginamit nyo, pagpunta ng China din.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Yes, November 12, 2018, PR356 going to China, personal... Money pa rin nyo yan?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Yes, I'm very sure it's personal money.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: So mahilig ka palang pumunta ang China on your personal... Sino kasama mo pala nitong November 2018? At bakit two days lang po?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Wait, I can't recall. There was a travel in China na parang sister city.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Mayroon po kaming travel na ganun.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Kaya nga po, bakit two days lang? Napakabilis ata. At personal travel lang yun? Kumbaga, magbabakasyon ako pero two days lang.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: So, again, ulitin ko, personal to o may nag-sponsor?

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Siguro, baka pwedeng, I will submit official document para sigurado lang po tayo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Very good.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Same ruling, Senator Judge Raffy. The Clerk of Court is directed to coordinate with

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Engineer Jimmy. Alam mo, Engineer,

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: kaya kita tinatanong tungkol sa China travel. Dahil si VP, yung colleague, Cali88 na kung saan partner dito si Tony Carpio na asba ni Sara Duterte at isa

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: sa mga co-owners. Nakatanggap ng 319 million pesos yung Cali88. Inward remittance from China and Hong Kong. So hindi maganda pakinggan. Malaman ng mga Pilipino na tumatanggap ang isang government official, especially napakataas yung katungkulan sa ating gobyerno, tumanggap ng salapi mula sa China na kung saan ay nagkakaroon tayo ng hidwaan sa West Philippine Sea. Gets? Salamat po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator Judge Raffy. Senator Judge Bam Aquino is recognized. You have two minutes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Maraming salamat, Mr. Presiding Officer. My question is for the prosecution initially. Magandang araw, Atty. Tolosa.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Good afternoon, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Okay. Nais ko lang kasing iibalik yung diskusyon dun sa properties. So, can you refresh our memory? From the prosecution's perspective, meron po bang property na pagmamayari ni Vice President? Duterte o ng kanyang asawa na hindi po nakalagay sa SALN. What is the position of the prosecution?

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. As testified to by the Register of Deeds of the City of Davao, that is the property covered by TCT No. 146-202401-0775.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Ito yung pinag-uusapan natin ngayong araw?

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: So isa lang ang isang property ang nakita ninyo na wala sa kanyang SALN?

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. That was the property identified by the RD, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Okay. One property in Davao City. Meron bang property sa Samal?

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: So, could you tell us the, in your, sa position po ng prosecution, ilang properties ang hindi na deklara ni Vice President Sara sa kanyang sale?

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Yes, based on what has been presented by our witnesses, one in the city of Davao and another one, Your Honor, in the...

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Igakos, or the island garden of Samal, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Okay, so we're talking about two properties. Yung susunod na witness, yun yung sa Samal.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: We believe so, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Okay. So right now, ang defense, ang posisyon nila, parehas yung nakalagay na Barangay 74A dito sa pinag-uusapan natin. Ang posisyon nyo, hindi ito magkaparehas.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: That is correct, Your Honor, because of the glaring discrepancies between the two.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Okay. So pag minatch ninyo yung mga properties sa Davao sa Register of Deeds at sa SALN, lampas ba dun sa dami ng nadeklara niyang property o parehas ang numero? Do you understand my question? Kunyari kung 19 yan, 19 rin ba yung Register of Deeds, 19 rin yung sa SALN o 20 yung nasa Register of Deeds at 19 yung sa SALN? For example.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Yes. We were not able to check all of the properties with the RD. But because the point is, even if the witness will present that summary of all properties under the name of the spouses,

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: That will only cover properties which they already transferred under their names. So it will not cover properties which they did not yet transfer under their name. So it is possible that this property indicated in the SALN was not yet transferred under their name. So it will not be reflected. in any summary that he will produce. It's the same thing, Your Honor. For example, even if the Vice President admitted she has financial interest in GenCorp, if you check the GIS, she will not be reflected as a stockholder or director, but still, she admitted that she has interest there.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Okay. Sige. Magkaiba yung... Yung Gen Corp. At medyo baka iba to kasi ito mabibilang natin eh. Mabibilang mo yung dami ng lupa, mabibilang mo yung nakarehistro, mabibilang mo yung nasa SALN.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: So, anyway, again, we're not supposed to do the work of the defense or the prosecution. Pero siguro po, hiningin na rin ni Sen. Risa yung mga detalye ng lahat ng properties sa Davao City ni Mans Carpio, Sara Duterte Carpio, or Joint. Pag na-submit na po yun, magandang mabangga natin yan dun sa SALN, makita natin yung dami ng mga properties para makita natin ano ba yung probability. Kasi sabi ng witness, highly probable, probable, possible. Pero siguro pag nandyan na po yung datos, pag na-submit nyo na po yan sa clerk of court at may presenta po sa amin, mas magiging malinaw kung ano ba itong pinag-uusapan nating loting ito. Kung ito ba'y labis. Doon sa nakarehistro o kulang ba ito sa mga nakalagay sa SALN? Maraming salamat, Mr. President Officer. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you very much, Senator Judge Bam Aquino. There being no other Senator Judges who wishes to make interjections, before I excuse Engineer Jimmy, without raising the hopes of some of the Senator Judges, even if Engineer Jimmy submits the list, As pointed out by Attorney Tolosa earlier, and as which we have seen earlier, ang babanggitin sa mga title, technical description lamang naman na kailangan ibangga dun sa pangalan lamang ng barangay na binabanggit sa SALN. So, it'll still be the same position that we will find ourselves in after we get the list because kailangan mo pa rin banggain yung nakalagay sa TCT na technical description lamang, wala namang house and street number, kumpara sa barangay na nakalagay sa SALN.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Anyway,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: we would like to thank you, Engineer Jimmy, para po sa inyong oras, panahon at pagsagot sa mga katanungan at pagupo bilang testigo sa hukumang ito. Maraming salamat po. You're excused, sir.

turns.speaker: Engr. Jaime G. Adalin
turns.text: Maraming salamat po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: As agreed upon by the parties, as stated by the Chair earlier, we shall adjourn at this point and shall resume tomorrow morning at 10 a.m. for the direct examination of

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Engineer John Kenneth Enumerables. Thereafter, the City Accountant, Ms. Bahan. And thereafter, the Punong Barangay. Trial is adjourned until tomorrow at 10 a.m.
